tools.name: search_sermons
tools.description: Search published sermons by keywords, topics, Bible book, preacher, church or language. Returns titles, preachers, churches, dates, topics, main Bible passages and links; never transcripts.

tools.name: get_sermon
tools.description: One published sermon's details: Sermon Registry's summary and takeaways, preacher, church, date, topics, Bible passages and links. No transcript text.

tools.name: find_churches
tools.description: Find churches listed on Sermon Registry by name, city, country or denomination, with links to their profiles.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: Every sermon topic id with its name and group, for use with search_sermons.
